Don't go to this restaurant EVER
Dec 2023 • Family
DISGUSTING EXPERIENCE NEVER EVER GO TO THIS RESTAURANT 

I would want to give zero rating to this restaurant 

We had gone for dinner on 8.12.23.

The property looked good.

We were asked to go on the 3rd floor. 

We placed our order & THEN WE WAITED & WAITED & WAITED BUT THE FOOD NEVER CAME.

After waiting for over 1.5 hours we left the restaurant without eating anything.

We ordered food at 8.55 pm & left at 10.20 pm with no food served!!!

The owner / manager who bragged about his restaurants did not have the courtesy to come & apologize for the delay even once !!!

When v left he was nowhere to be seen !!!

Along with us 6- 8 other guests also left without eating.

ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING EXPERIENCE, ABSOLUTELY ARROGANT MANAGEMENT.

APPEARS THAT THEY HAVE GROWN TOO BIG TO CARE FOR THE CUSTOMERS.

GO TO THIS RESTAURANT AT YOUR OWN PERIL !
